observation.visible_scene: A scratched, stained metal surface (pan/sheet) holds two piles of glossy, viscous candy-like goo. On the left, a white lollipop stick lies diagonally across a flat smear of bright green goo, with a thin strand of green looping off the stick's upper end. On the right sits a larger rounded blob swirled with green, yellow and a streak of blue, its center mottled with orange-brown speckles. The composition is viewed from a fixed, slightly angled overhead camera.
visible_changes: The only discernible change across the excerpt is slow, minor internal activity within the right-hand blob: small bubbles appear and shift position inside the green areas (most noticeably a cluster forming in the lower-left green region and a few specks near the middle), while the blob's outer outline stays the same.

The white stick, the green smear and drip on the left, the orange-brown mottled center, and the background scratches/stains remain in fixed positions throughout; no object translates, rotates, or deforms.
The camera is static (background texture does not move), so observed changes are object-internal, not camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the bubbling continues, subsides, or leads to any setting/hardening after the crop ends.
What produced or placed the goo and the stick, and any earlier action before t=0.
The exact material identity of the substances.
uncertain_details: Whether faint intensity shifts in the orange-brown speckled center are real physical change or compression noise.
Whether the blob's edge undergoes any sub-pixel spreading; the outline appears constant within the excerpt.
